rules.remediation: Move provider selection and runtime client setup to app or platform boundaries; inject or import stable platform functions from features.

evidence: generic helper file contains feature nouns
shared function changes one product workflow only
rules.remediation: Move product behavior to the owning feature and keep support code domain-neutral.
Split helpers by stable responsibility or move feature-specific code back to its feature.

evidence: feature A imports feature B internal path
component from one feature is used directly by another feature
rules.remediation: Expose an intentional public surface or move shared behavior to a neutral layer after proving reuse.

evidence: support imports app or feature code
rules.remediation: Invert the dependency: app composes features and platform, while platform/support remain feature-agnostic.

evidence: callers import from feature internal folders
rules.remediation: Create or use an intentional feature public surface and keep internal files private.

evidence: external input passed directly to feature service
feature internals repeatedly coerce unknown values
rules.remediation: Parse and normalize input at transport, persistence, job, or integration boundary.
Declare fast, targeted, and release validation lanes in project instructions or Skopos workflows.

evidence: generated path has no owning command
generated file is edited without source regeneration
rules.remediation: Document source owner and regeneration command; edit source/generator first, then regenerate.
